entities.name: Michael Bloomberg

entities.name: Fritz Thyssen

entities.name: Prescott Sheldon Bush

entities.name: George H.W. Bush

entities.name: George W. Bush

entities.name: Carlyle Group

entities.name: Halliburton

entities.name: Stephen Schwarzman

entities.name: Blackstone Group

entities.name: John S. and James L. Knight Foundation
